degree_rationale: How the First Image was formed and the sun and moon shaped after it — the seven goods of the sun (light, rest, vigilance, nourishing, gathering creeping things, plague-healing, manifesting heaven) and the seven evils of the night. Treats the completed signaling system of cosmic time.
direction_rationale: The set sun/moon as ultimating signs that finish the cosmic disposition — settled, daily-functioning. West = the established cosmic clock.
grand_man_function: Spiritual luminary-completion — sun/moon as cosmic seals.
title: How the First Image was formed and the sun and moon shaped after it
